title: Chromosome replication across a lineage (seed 0)
caption: Fork positions, fork pairs, oriC count and dry mass over a seed-0 lineage.
interpretation: Multi-panel replication view for the seed-0 lineage: DNA-polymerase fork positions sweep oriC->terC, replication-fork pairs and the oriC count rise 2->4 then reset to 2 at division, tracking dry-mass growth. Confirms the expected coordinated replication program.
simulations: 2-seed x 2-gen wild-type baseline ensemble (showcase2-baseline-full), Ray-parallel, XArray/zarr + parquet emit.
